prompt: A single footstep of a walking skeleton on a stone floor: a bare bone foot lands with a light, brittle click, the dry bones of the leg rattle and settle for an instant, a faint scrape of bone on stone. Hollow dry bone only, no flesh, no boots, no armour, no clank. Very short, one step, over at once. Retro 1990s first-person fantasy game sound effect, dry, punchy, no music.
